description: Only films with a replacement cost above 20.99 are included. A cost of exactly 20.99 is left out.

a.request: Among films whose replacement cost is more than 20.99, compute for each rating the average of `rental_rate` divided by `rental_duration` (ignoring missing values). Then take the simple mean of these per-rating averages, ignoring missing ones. If that overall mean exists, list each rating whose average is strictly greater than it, showing the rating, its average, and how far its average is above the overall mean (all unrounded).
a.sql:
WITH filtered_films AS (
  SELECT film_id, rating, rental_rate, rental_duration
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
),
rating_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_duration
  FROM filtered_films
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_duration) AS overall_avg
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT 
  ra.rating,
  ra.avg_rate_per_duration,
  ra.avg_rate_per_duration - om.overall_avg AS difference
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ra.avg_rate_per_duration > om.overall_avg
ORDER BY ra.rating

c.request: Using 20.99 as the replacement-cost cutoff for films, compute for each rating the average of `rental_rate` divided by `rental_duration` over the qualifying films (ignoring missing values). Then take the simple mean of these per-rating averages, ignoring missing ones. If that overall mean exists, list each rating whose average is strictly greater than it, showing the rating, its average, and how far its average is above the overall mean (all unrounded). Only films with a replacement cost above 20.99 are included. A cost of exactly 20.99 is left out.
c.sql:
WITH filtered_films AS (
  SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
),
rating_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_duration
  FROM filtered_films
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_duration) AS overall_avg
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT 
  ra.rating,
  ra.avg_rate_duration,
  (ra.avg_rate_duration - om.overall_avg) AS above_mean
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ra.avg_rate_duration > om.overall_avg
ORDER BY ra.rating;

b.request: Among films with replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99, calculate for each rating the average of (rental_rate / rental_duration), compute the simple mean of these per-rating averages, and report each rating whose per-rating average strictly exceeds the overall mean, showing the rating, its per-rating average, and the absolute difference above the overall mean, all values unrounded.
b.sql: WITH filtered_films AS (SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99), rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS per_rating_avg FROM filtered_films GROUP BY rating), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(per_rating_avg) AS mean_value FROM rating_averages) SELECT ra.rating, ra.per_rating_avg, ra.per_rating_avg - om.mean_value AS absolute_difference FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE ra.per_rating_avg > om.mean_value

d.request: Filter films with replacement_cost > 20.99, then for each rating calculate the mean of rental_rate divided by rental_duration; compute the simple mean of these per-rating means; list each rating where its mean is strictly greater than the overall mean, showing the rating, its mean, and the difference above the overall mean (all unrounded).
d.sql: WITH filtered_films AS (SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99), rating_means AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS rating_mean FROM filtered_films GROUP BY rating), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(rating_mean) AS overall_avg FROM rating_means) SELECT rm.rating, rm.rating_mean, rm.rating_mean - om.overall_avg AS difference FROM rating_means rm CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE rm.rating_mean > om.overall_avg ORDER BY rm.rating
